liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: Thomas Rymer, Foedera (new edition, 1816), I 3: the printed text of William I’s writ
liebermann.notes: In Wl ep, Liebermann’s Ry is the text printed in the 1816 edition of Rymer’s Foedera, whose source he could not trace (Rymer’s reference to the Red Book of the Exchequer is wrong); its lost source is his ry. Elsewhere Ry is a transcript made for that edition (see the next entry).
